aboutGame.title: What is WARDOGS?
paragraphs: WARDOGS is a tactical all-out warfare FPS developed by BULKHEAD and published by Team17. Up to 100 players are divided across three teams and fight over randomized Control Zones inside a huge modern military sandbox featuring infantry combat, vehicles, construction, destruction, and proximity voice communication.

Every player begins with cash and purchases weapons, equipment, and vehicles for each life. Money earned from kills, revives, transportation, objectives, and other teamplay actions persists between matches, turning economic decisions and teamwork into a major part of progression.

items.question: What is WARDOGS?
items.answer: WARDOGS is a tactical all-out warfare FPS built around large-scale, three-team Control Zone matches with infantry, vehicles, construction, destruction, and a persistent cash economy.

items.question: When does WARDOGS enter Early Access?
items.answer: The researched Steam listing gives September 10, 2026 as the Early Access date. Check the official Steam page for the current listing.

items.question: Does this wiki replace the official game site?
items.answer: No. This is an independent guide site; official links are provided for access, announcements, and community channels.
